answers.reason: Professors are members of the university, but the description does not explicitly grant them a seat in the senate.
Budget planning allocates funds and touches the university-wide plan, involving groups of higher rank.
An appointment committee selects candidates for vacant professorships, which directly involves professors.
Professors belong to a faculty and participate in the affairs of that faculty.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of students, and professors are part of the academic and faculty structure handling these.
